coordinate_convention: row,col at 6m grid; x=6*col; z=12282-6*row; positive row moves south.
height_sources: B EV82 fixed base and H EV87 offline candidate; arrays only, no solver.
water_distance_definition: Euclidean distance in XZ from vertex to nearest local positive-area polygon where affine P, finite all-corner F triangle, or SEA=0.85 exceeds H affine terrain; water polygons built only in local cells row/col ±5, so null means no local polygon, not global absence.
